en.headline: Jewellery and cash worth HK$610,000 stolen from Repulse Bay flat
en.dek: A 52-year-old woman reported a forced window and opened jewellery boxes after returning home early on Tuesday; no arrests yet.
body: A 52-year-old woman reported the theft of about HK$610,000 worth of jewellery and cash from her Repulse Bay home early on Tuesday morning.
Police received the report from the woman, surnamed Chan, at 12.30am after she returned home to find a window forced open and several jewellery boxes opened.

Initial estimates put the loss at about HK$600,000 in jewellery and about HK$10,000 in cash. The case has been classified as burglary and is being handled by the Western police district crime investigation team. No arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 淺水灣住宅遭爆竊 損失約61萬元珠寶現金
zh.dek: 一名52歲姓陳女子周二凌晨返家發現窗戶被撬開及多個首飾盒被翻開，報失約61萬元財物，暫無人被捕。
body: 一名52歲女子周二凌晨報稱其淺水灣住宅遭爆竊，損失約61萬元珠寶及現金。
警方於凌晨12時30分接獲該名姓陳女子報案，她返家後發現窗戶被撬開，多個首飾盒被翻開。
初步估計損失約60萬元珠寶及約1萬元現金。案件列作爆竊，由西區警區刑事調查隊跟進，暫無人被捕。
